name: Tick Tock Clock / sparse four-live representative
oracle:
**Crank**

This enters the arena with a steam counter. At the start of your turn, destroy this and it deals 1 damage to you unless you remove a steam counter from it.

When a Mechanologist attack action card you control hits a hero, destroy this and up to 2 other items in the arena. Then deal X damage to them, where X is the number of items destroyed this way. Representative only: actual_item_enters_with_one_steam_and_declines_crank. Other pitch siblings, alternate targets and unexercised branches receive no credit. All four live/manual; only native entry-point actions.
